label: Cessation coverage and ungiven continuation comparison
paraphrase: For arbitrary sampled process models, causal coverage of cessation and no terminal destructive cause give double-negated next presence of the same initially present bearer. Continued weak giving is classically equivalent to failure of continuation without any giver. Coverage plus that failure premise yields a terminal process witness whenever a previously present recipient has no next giver. The existing ConcurrentlyActualized premise restricts to continued giving on a matching selected-world process dictionary. Reused temporal inertia and sustained histories respectively satisfy causal coverage with failure and success of concurrent actualization; the inertial process dictionary contains a sound actual loss of the other bearer. These are conditional laws and structural interpretations, not actual conservation or rival defeat.
